title: Qt: Reload Lua FileHandler when having a capture file
description:
Support reloading a Lua FileHandler when this is in use for a
loaded capture file. Prompt to save the file if having unsaved
changes because the file must be reloaded.

Fixes #17615

notes.body: @devanlai Have a look at this proposal to fix #17615.

@stigbjorlykke, it seems to work okay on the original dns.iphex sample, but when I test with a different file that uses a lua-based heuristic dissector, it triggers an actual access violation.

I've attached a sample heuristic dissector that dissects any UDP payload with more than two bytes and a modified version of the custom `.iphex` file that changes the port number on the first packet from 53 to 54 so that it can be dissected by the lua dissector.
* [dissector.lua](/uploads/cb317c8d5ce7c497eef35a29efcd5d97/dissector.lua)
* [notdns.iphex](/uploads/77c61b29f865ae83744b9e0c2e29ea83/notdns.iphex)

@devanlai The issue with your heuristics Lua dissector is not related to the FileHandler fixes, this also happens when using a pcap file on a standard Wireshark version. You should create a separate Issue for that one.

Hmm, I was able to get it to crash on a standard Wireshark build the first time after you mentioned it, but not on any of my subsequent attempts. I guess I must have just lucked all the other times I used the reload lua plugin feature with my real heuristic dissector. I'll see if I can get a consistent set of steps to reproduce the crash on a normal build.
I get a consistent crash on macOS so I will continue investigate this bug as well. But it's always good to log it as a separate Issue.
Have a look at MR !4324 for a fix to the heuristics Lua dissector crash.
Per my comment on !4324, I'm satisfied that the root cause of this crash is unrelated to these changes and that !4324 fixes it.

commits_data.message:
Lua: Free FileHandler on deregister

Free FileHandler and all allocated strings on deregister to avoid
memory leak when reloading Lua plugins.
